description: FIle with the dialogue to play

version.description: The version number for the conversation file format.

backdrop.description: Data on the backdrop for the conversation, behind the dialogue box.

type.description: The type of backdrop to use.

fadeTime.description: The time for the backdrop to fully fade in

outro.description: Data on the outro for the conversation.

type.description: The type of outro to use.

fadeTime.description: The time to fully fade out (if applicable).

music.description: Data for the music to be played.

asset.description: The path to the music you want to play for the duration of this dialogue

fadeTime.description: The time for the music to fully fade in

looped.description: If true, the song will play in loop, otherwise it plays only once

speakerAnimation.description: Whethever to flip Y axis of this speaker when playing this animation.

box.description: Which dialogue box to use for this line of dialogue.

boxAnimation.description: Which animation to play for the dialogue box.

text.description: The text that will display for this line of dialogue. When the user advances the dialogue, the next entry in the array will concatenate on.

speed.description: The relative speed at which text gets "typed out".Setting `speed` to `1.5` would make it look like the character is speaking quickly, and setting `speed` to `0.5` would make it look like the character is emphasizing each word.
